title: Better Item Names
description: Better, more known and more used names for items and blocks.
body:
# **Better Item Names**
****

This little Resource Pack **changes** item and block **names** to more used and more popularized names in the MC-Community, like e.g.: 

- Enchanted Golden Apple --> **God Apple**
- Nether Star --> **Wither Star**
- Fire Charge --> **Fireball**
- Netherite Upgrade --> **Smithing Template**

This pack also makes some item names just a little more optimal, e.g.:

- Ender Chest --> **Enderchest**
- End Stone --> **Endstone**

It makes some item names closer to the other items of that category: 

- Leather Tunic --> **Leather Chestplate**
- Mangrove Propagule --> **Mangrove Sapling**
- Warped Stem --> **Warped Log**

It also fixes and changes some names that are to similar to each other, like:

- Bricks --> **Brick Block**
- Resin Bricks --> **Resin Brick Block**
- Clay --> **Clay Block**

...and more :).
**Full list** of the changed item names **in Gallery!**


It is **compatible** with: other **Resource Packs**, most **Mods** and **Clients** and has the advantage of working on almost every **MC-Server** (works **client-side**)!
This Resource Pack uses realistic and just more optimal item names, not hilarious or silly ones.


Note: It just changes the names of the items, not the command for getting them! But the changed item names are showing up by searching them in the inventory or the crafting table. 

**IMPORTANT**: It ONLY works if you are playing in English (**English, US**). Otherwise it will not work! 

## License & Permissions

**Allowed:** You are allowed to download, play with, and share this resource pack with others.         
**NOT Allowed:** You are NOT allowed to modify this pack, create your own version of it, commercialize/monetize it, or re-upload it to other websites!


Thank you for downloading and playing my pack :). More updates coming soon...
